title: High Availability parity depth (HA-01/HA-02)
acceptance_criteria: VRRP groups support per-address interface bindings and preserve them from existing config.
HA save diff emits correct set/delete operations when an address interface binding changes.
VRRP, sync-group, virtual-server, and real-server forms reject invalid numeric/semantic combinations before apply.
Build/runtime gates pass: frontend typecheck, targeted eslint, production build, runtime smoke, UI smoke.
assumptions: This slice deepens HA option parity but does not complete full HA guide parity.
Live dual-node failover behavior verification remains for HA-03.

tasks.notes: Added VRRP address-interface mapping support and diff-safe command generation for rebinding.
Added pre-submit validation for VRRP/IPVS/sync-group semantics and numeric ranges.
Validated with typecheck, targeted eslint, build, runtime smoke, and browser smoke after vm-ui restart.
Continue HA-01/HA-02 depth (inline edit UX and remaining guide leaves), then move to HA-03 verification artifacts.
Reviewer-agent spawn hit thread cap; manual in-process review completed with APPROVED verdict after gate reruns.
